name: China Youran Dairy Group Limited
summary: China Youran Dairy Group Limited functions as an investment holding company, offering a comprehensive suite of products and services to the upstream dairy industry across the People's Republic of China. Its operations are divided into two primary segments: Raw Milk Business and Comprehensive Ruminant Farming Solutions. The company directly supplies raw milk to dairy manufacturers. Furthermore, it supports dairy farms by providing nutritious concentrated feed and forage grass, alongside advanced genetic products such as frozen bovine semen, sex-sorted frozen bovine semen, and embryos, complemented by breeding solutions. China Youran also distributes various ruminant farming essentials, including veterinary drugs and animal husbandry equipment, through its online retail platform, Jumuc.com, and a network of offline pick-up stores. The company, founded in 1984, is headquartered in Hohhot, China.
